channel.title: Lemmuel Turaya — Portfolio Changelog
channel.description: Versioned log of what ships on lemmuel-turaya / kon2raya portfolio — features, fixes, and content updates.

item.title: v4.0 — Round 2: polish, proof, performance
item.description: Round 2 of the employer-attention pass. Wired up the work-filter chips (data-tags driven, persisted in localStorage), swapped the "Coffee Cups ∞" hero stat for "Case Studies", added the "last shipped" footer stamp pulled from document.lastModified, scaffolded the third case study (jbc-commission-system) with its own OG card. Dropped image weight by ~3.4 MB (logo, mylogo orphan deleted, cover photo re-encoded to WebP). Light theme received a sweeping contrast audit: 163 → 3 outstanding contrast issues, with hero overlay neutralized, HUD widget themed, hero cover hidden in light, and the developer.js code-card now mirrors profile-config as a light editor pane.

item.title: v3.9 — Dev-signal files
item.description: Added humans.txt, /.well-known/security.txt, /api/availability.json (curl-able hiring status), this very feed.xml (RSS for the changelog), and a real git-log footer that pulls the last commits from GitHub.

item.title: v3.5 — Round 1 employer-attention pass
item.description: Unlocked + indexed both case studies, added per-case OG images, dropped DRAFT banners. Added "shipped impact" section between work and hire CTA. New 4-step engagement flow + Hiring/Client tab toggle in the hire card. Shipped a service worker delivering on the PWA manifest. Added /now.html, footer link to /now/uses/changelog. Light theme toggle in the nav with FOUC-prevention bootstrap.

item.title: v3.4 — Dev-credibility passes
item.description: Added /uses.html (editor, terminal, hardware, daily software). Added resume.json in JSON Resume format. Added the /changelog page itself.

item.title: v3.3 — Case-study scaffolds
item.description: Initial case-studies/wms.html and case-studies/pamanaland.html. Shared case-study.css with window-chrome code blocks, metric grid, CTA cards. Draft framing pending polish.

item.title: v3.2 — Hire funnel
item.description: Cal.com booking button in Hire Me card. Designed cover.html for the OG image. Interactive dev terminal (press ` to open). UTM-aware welcome pill. LinkedIn copy-paste pack with full content blocks.

item.title: v3.1 — Ship-readiness
item.description: JSON-LD Person schema, sitemap.xml, robots.txt, PWA manifest. Netlify Forms with honeypot. Real-time visitor counter (counterapi.dev). Live GitHub events graph & recent-repos panel. Skip-to-content, focus-visible, auto-ARIA on icon-only buttons. 404 in terminal style. Matrix/particles pause when offscreen.

item.title: v3.0 — Major cyber-themed redesign
item.description: Full redesign from generic template into a dev-by-dev cyber-themed portfolio. Dark cyber gradient + neon grid. Reworked About, Resume, Services, Skills, Tools & Stack, Work, Case Studies, and Hire Me sections end-to-end.
